description:
“We... must have intercourse.” 

That is the only way to escape. The Hebei Peng Family and the Zhuge Family are two clans that couldn't be more different. Min-young of the Hebei Peng Family and Hyeon of the Zhuge Family meet at a remote inn while traveling to the Great Martial Arts Tournament hosted by Shaolin, the pillar of the Murim world. There, they hear about the mysterious disappearance of several couples, and an excited Min-young impulsively steps forward to help. 

“Young lady, this could be more dangerous than you think. Please, calm down.” 

“Are you trying to stop me even though you know I am a child of the Hebei Peng Family?” 

She really should have listened to him. At twenty years old, on her very first outing, Min-young’s attempt to help others leads her to be trapped in none other than a 'stone coffin'- a place they cannot leave unless they engage in physical union.
